findings.namedBuyers: Two named operational routing candidates, not verified contract owners: Lydia Bourquin, Events & Trade Marketing Project Manager at Hublot, whose current public profile describes event budgets, logistics, vendor selection/negotiations and VIP hospitality; and Rebecca Saïer, Senior HRBP Product development, Marketing & Sales at Hublot, relevant for HR/onboarding referrals. Rebecca’s recruitment, integration, training and reception-management responsibilities are evidenced in earlier Hublot positions, not established as her current accommodation remit. The official Manufacture Experience & Hospitality Manager vacancy is a stronger function-level target but names no incumbent. No named lodging buyer or signing authority verified.
findings.futureEdition: No next officially published exact-dated H3 opening, commissioning, mobilisation, relocation or training activity was located for 2026-12-08–2028-06-30. A September 2026 CEO interview transcript says “you will hear a lot about it in 2027 because that will be the grand opening of that facility”; this is a year-only indication from a third-party transcript, not an official dated invitation. Immobilier.ch reported on 2026-10-27 that H3 was already active, ramping up through year-end, and “Une inauguration sera alors agendée, sans qu’on ne connaisse encore la date précise.” Article and vacancy publication dates are not activity dates. Future start/end dates remain null.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: Nyon / La Côte activity is geographically relevant to Founex, so this is not automatically a territory stretch. The more credible test is visiting operational teams, trainers, agency staff or delegates whose lodging is independently sourced, rather than assumed employee relocation. YOTEL’s 237 guestrooms and six meeting rooms could support a modest negotiated block or ancillary workshop; 20–120 rooms is a hotel-side prospecting envelope, NOT published Hublot demand. No verified attendance, stays, room nights or peak-room requirement supports a block today. The brand’s high-end VIP expectations may be less compatible with this hotel than operational-team stays. H3’s own visitor/showroom and meeting infrastructure weakens an automatic off-site meeting-space thesis. Banquet/catering scale at YOTEL remains unverified; no resort requirement is evidenced.
findings.venueCommitments: Physical project site: Hublot H3 manufacture, La Vuarpillière industrial campus, Nyon, Canton of Vaud, Switzerland — Nyon / La Côte territory, not Geneva city, Lausanne or French Pays de Gex. Hublot publishes its head-office/manufacture address as Ch. de la Vuarpillière 33, 1260 Nyon; that is the campus contact address, not a separately verified H3 entrance. Sources establish the company-owned-use industrial site, not a hotel booking or a contracted future inauguration venue. H3 includes visitor reception/showroom and internal meeting areas.
findings.historicalRotation: No destination rotation or recurring conference series established. This is a fixed Nyon industrial-campus development: original plant opened in 2009; H2 inauguration took place on 29 September 2015; H3 was reported in delivery/activation during 2026. The municipal 2022 planning report anticipated entry in summer 2025, while Coretra later stated delivery planned in 2026 and October 2026 reporting described ongoing activation. These are planning/completion stages, not interchangeable event dates or proof of annual recurrence.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No H3-specific official housing bureau, host-hotel booking, published hotel block, hotel RFP, relocation accommodation policy or independently bookable room requirement was found. LVMH’s Manufacture Experience & Hospitality Manager vacancy documents an internal pathway: “overseeing hospitality operations at our Manufacture in Nyon” and “Ensuring seamless communication and coordination between local markets and Headquarters for incoming delegation visits.” It covers reception, catering, logistics, agencies and guest journeys, but does not mention accommodation purchasing. The only sourced hotel package identified is historical: Mandarin Oriental, Geneva, “Suite Luxury of Time”, “Valid until 31 December 2013”, with suite accommodation, airport transfers and Hublot atelier transfers. That is not an H3 room block or a current commitment. No current edition-specific hotel list was located.
findings.organizationStructure: Hublot SA is the corporate watch manufacturer and project client, part of LVMH; not an association, PCO or DMC. Hublot is the prospective demand owner; H3 is its manufacture/visitor facility, not an external event organizer. The official hospitality vacancy places visitor-experience coordination within Hublot, with external agencies participating in delivery; no appointed housing agency or accommodation intermediary is identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No Radisson commitment, current incumbent hotel, overflow shortage or H3 room-block arrangement was established. This means unknown, not available. The historical Mandarin Oriental Geneva package demonstrates a luxury visitor-hospitality relationship only through 31 December 2013; it cannot establish current exclusivity or displacement opportunity. H3 provides its own showroom, reception and meeting facilities, limiting the case for selling a replacement event venue. Hublot’s luxury-service standards are explicit; suitability for VIP lodging must be tested rather than assumed.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Use Hublot’s published head-office route, info@hublot.com / +41 22 990 90 00, to request Lydia Bourquin and the person responsible for Manufacture Experience & Hospitality. Ask for exact 2027 opening/visitor-programme dates, any remaining H3 contractor or relocation stays, overnight origins, room peaks/length of stay, current hotels and exclusivity, and whether HQ, markets or an agency books. Ask Rebecca Saïer to route HR/onboarding accommodation questions rather than treating her as a confirmed buyer. Only if independently bookable demand exists, propose a small trial allocation with transport, breakfast and extended-stay terms priced after requirements are known. Keep as relationship development; do not publish a dated event opportunity yet.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Not currently sales-qualified as a dated event or relocation project: no exact future activity date, independently sourced accommodation requirement or open procurement route verified. H3 being already active does not prove remaining contractor stays or staff relocation. The hospitality vacancy was published 10 November 2026, but that is recruitment evidence, not a guest-arrival or programme-start date. Do not mark sourcing open, inventory available or business committed elsewhere.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional inference: an internal guest-experience function and incoming delegation visits create a credible relationship-development route, with a year-only 2027 grand-opening signal. They do not establish recurring overnight demand. Target non-VIP project/support teams or small delegations only after Hublot confirms who travels, dates, overnight need and existing agreements. Neither an annual cycle nor 2028 activity is verified.
